requirements.text: Ph.D. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
8+ years of experience in AI/ML research, engineering, or data science.
Demonstrated depth in at least one of: computer vision, representation learning, or reinforcement learning.
Strong publication record in computational methods, machine learning, or related research areas.
Expert-level Python and PyTorch skills, with proficiency in the modern data science ecosystem (e.g., pandas, scikit-learn).
Experience with cloud infrastructure, preferably AWS, is a plus.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced startup environment.

We're looking for an experienced AI Research Engineer to join our AI & Data Science team and turn cutting-edge research into technologies that power breakthrough imaging and sensing applications. This role sits naturally where computer vision, representation learning, and reinforcement learning meet. You'll work on problems such as learning real-time acquisition policies that adapt how our sensors capture a scene, and building representations that transfer across imaging modalities. This is a full-time on-site position based in our San Mateo, CA office.
